lead: Nutrients your eyes are hungry for. Lutein, bilberry and eyebright with vitamins C and E, zinc and copper — to promote eye health, help protect against everyday eye strain, and keep your vision healthy as you age.

science.title: Why eyes need their own nutrients
science.text: Your eyes work hard — and screens, sunlight and age all take a toll. The macula relies on lutein to filter harmful blue light, while antioxidants like vitamins C and E and zinc protect delicate eye tissue from oxidative stress. Bilberry has long been used to support night vision and healthy microcirculation, and eyebright is a classic herbal eye tonic. Together they're a daily multivitamin for your eyes.

format.title: A multivitamin for your eyes
format.text: Not a general multi — a focused blend of the carotenoids, antioxidants and botanicals your eyes specifically use, in two easy capsules a day.

absorb.title: Filter, protect, nourish
absorb.lead: Lutein settles into the macula to filter light, antioxidants shield eye tissue, and bilberry supports the tiny vessels that feed your eyes.

points.title: Lutein in the macula
points.text: A carotenoid that concentrates in the macula and helps filter harmful blue light.

points.title: Bilberry anthocyanins
points.text: Traditionally used to support night vision and the healthy microcirculation that nourishes the eye.

points.title: Antioxidant shield
points.text: Vitamins C and E, zinc and copper help protect eye tissue from everyday oxidative stress.

ingredients.title: Carotenoids, botanicals & vitamins
ingredients.lead: The nutrients your eyes use most, in two capsules.*

items.name: Lutein
items.text: The carotenoid that concentrates in the macula and helps filter harmful blue light from screens and sun.

items.name: Bilberry
items.text: Rich in anthocyanins, traditionally used to support night vision and healthy eye microcirculation.

items.name: Eyebright
items.text: A classic herbal eye tonic, long used to soothe and support tired, strained eyes.

items.name: Vitamins + Zinc
items.text: 500 mg vitamin C, 30 mg vitamin E, plus zinc and copper to protect eye tissue and support normal vision.

facts.note: ** The % Daily Value (DV) tells you how much a nutrient in a serving contributes to a daily diet (2,000 calories a day used for general advice). *** Daily Value (DV) not established.
facts.other: Other Ingredients: Gelatin (capsule), Brown Rice Flour.
facts.side_text: Lutein (from marigold), bilberry fruit, eyebright 10:1 extract, plus vitamins C and E, zinc and copper — in a gelatin capsule. Made in the USA — 60 capsules, 30 servings.
facts.warning: Contains gelatin (not vegetarian or vegan). If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition or take medication, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: Two capsules with water
steps.text: Take 2 capsules daily with 6–8 oz of water.

steps.title: With a meal
steps.text: Take them with food — lutein and vitamin E are fat-soluble and absorb better alongside a meal.

steps.title: Daily for best results
steps.text: Eye-nutrient levels build over time — take it consistently, especially if you spend long hours on screens.

series.label: Comfort
series.title: Less tired by evening
series.text: Lutein and antioxidants were associated with more comfortable eyes and less fatigue after long screen days.

series.label: Clarity
series.title: Sharper, steadier vision
series.text: Bilberry and lutein tracked with a sense of sharper visual clarity, including in dim light.

series.label: Protection
series.title: Support that adds up
series.text: A daily supply of eye-specific antioxidants supports the long-term health of your vision as you age.
